text:
maria: Quick flag — small usability issue in the Batch -> Preview -> Export flow. Screenshot + Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/vecs-export (attached)

maria: Root problem: CTA copy is inconsistent. Primary button reads "Export vectors" while the help text refers to "download CSV". Test users were unsure if "export" meant CSV, JSON, or an API export.

jamie: saw this in yesterday's lab too. Half expected a JSON payload. My suggestion: make the primary action explicit, e.g. "Download CSV" and expose other formats via a compact dropdown.

sean: Agreed on explicit CTA. Also the table density control is ambiguous — currently labeled "Compact density". For clarity and screen readers, change to "Row density" with options "Comfortable / Compact / Condensed".

lina: For a11y: ensure the density control has an aria-label like "Row density, current selection: Compact" and announce changes with an aria-live region (polite).

aqil: Modal copy nit: header says "Export Vectors" but body mentions "selected queries". Recommend "Export selected vectors to CSV" to avoid product jargon.

maria: Proposed changes:
1) Primary CTA: "Download CSV" + small dropdown: "Other formats: JSON, Parquet".
2) Export modal heading -> "Export selected vectors"; description -> "Download selected vectors as a CSV file. Includes id, embedding, and selected metadata fields.".
3) Density control -> "Row density" (Comfortable/Compact/Condensed) + SR hint "affects table row spacing for readability".
4) Add export progress aria-live: <div aria-live="polite" id="export-progress"> updates like "Preparing CSV..." and "Download ready".

jamie: One more UX thought — the preview truncates embedding vectors into a single line. Could we show a lightweight column-mapping popover on hover over the Export CTA: "Columns: id, embedding_vector, metadata.name"? Keep collapsed by default.

sean: Agree on popover but keep it unobtrusive for large selections (>50 rows). Maybe show a "View columns" link inside the export modal instead.

lina: Will add SR-only label for the popover and ensure keyboard focus shows the mapping dialog. Also will add instructions for screen reader users in the modal: "Use the Export formats menu to choose CSV, JSON, or Parquet.".

aqil: I'll draft the revised modal copy and dropdown labels and post a tiny copy PR later today for review.

designbot: Reminder: changes that touch export formats must update telemetry keys (export_type -> export_format). See docs: https://redwood.infra/docs/telemetry/export-events

maria: Thanks — I'll update Figma with the label / a11y notes and schedule a 15-minute sync tomorrow at 11:00 to run through the updates with Eng and PM. Assigning copy to @aqil and dropdown behavior to @jamie. :thumbsup:
